snippet.title: Pyrihel – Official Trailer | Open World Space Simulator
snippet.description:
Pyrihel is an open world space simulator: a seamless galaxy of 10,000 star systems where you can land on planets, dive into oceans, mine asteroids, hunt pirates and buy your own mobile base for your fleet – without loading screens.

⭐ Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5540790/

Fly from warp between the stars down to the surface of alien worlds in one seamless flight. Trade between stations, take on transport contracts, mine asteroids and planetary rings, skim gas giants, hunt wanted pirates or simply explore at your own pace. Later, command your own mobile base – a carrier with hangar space, storage, a factory and a refinery on board.

No story, no grind, no loading screens. Just a whole galaxy to explore.

🚀 Pyrihel is in development. Early Access on Steam is planned.
🖥️ PC via Steam – Windows & native Linux
🎮 Single-player
🌍 English & German

Pyrihel is made by Lodewood Labs, a one-person indie studio from Germany. The game is developed with Claude by Anthropic, guided by an experienced developer. All gameplay footage is captured in-game. Trailer music generated with Suno.
